item.description:
Nic's Morning Brief — Saturday 17 October 2026. Sport, business and tech in about six minutes.

Sport

  • Sharks v Lyon team news (12 changes, Hendrikse, Hatton capt, Lewies, Williams) (SABC Sport, 16 Oct 2026): sabcsport.com
  • Kick-off 14:00 SAST Sat 17 Oct; Cardiff Fri 23 Oct, Munster Sat 31 Oct (Sharks official fixtures page (live page, checked 17 Oct)): sharksrugby.co.za
  • Proteas second Test build-up (Markram missed training, Rabada firming, Ackerman/Breetzke, rain forecast, squad without Stubbs) (cricket.com.au, published ~00:00 SAST 17 Oct 2026): cricket.com.au
  • Stubbs dropped, Rickelton keeps (IOL, 15 Oct 2026 (older than 36h; supporting only, squad confirmed by the 17 Oct piece)): iol.co.za
  • Second Test dates/times, 18 Oct 10:00 (Cricket South Africa fixtures release): cricket.co.za
  • Frans Malherbe update (Planet Rugby, 16 Oct 2026 (date taken from earlier sample notes, not re-verified on page)): planetrugby.com

Business

  • Wall Street close 16 Oct (S&P -1.09%, Nasdaq -2.15%, worst week since June; CoreWeave -12%, bonds >15%; oil +3%; Warsh; Barclays hike call) (Reuters (via Honolulu Star-Advertiser), 16 Oct 2026): staradvertiser.com
  • US 10-year Treasury 5.09% on 16 Oct (US Treasury daily yield curve): home.treasury.gov
  • Europe: STOXX 600 +0.7% to 644.74, up >2% on week, best since late June; ASML, Aixtron, Nordex (Reuters via The Irish Times, 16 Oct 2026 18:27 IST): irishtimes.com
  • FTSE 100 best week in six months (+3.1%); four BoE hikes priced (Reuters via Investing.com, 16 Oct 2026): investing.com
  • Bank surcharge reportedly 3% to 8%, ~£2bn/yr; Lloyds, NatWest fall (CNBC, 16 Oct 2026 13:19 SAST): cnbc.com
  • Budget date: Wednesday 28 October 2026 (confirms 28th, not 29th) (HM Treasury / GOV.UK, 31 Jul 2026 (official reference, not news).; OBR): gov.uk · obr.uk
  • Singapore NODX +68.4% y/y in Sept; +27.6% in first nine months (Enterprise Singapore, 16 Oct 2026.; CNA, 16 Oct 2026 02:32 SAST): enterprisesg.gov.sg · channelnewsasia.com
  • Consulting UK: Big Four £1.5bn+ UK govt contracts in 2026 (Tussell); Deloitte £650m (City AM, 15 Oct 2026 14:42 SAST (~41h old, borderline).; government pushback: Bloomberg Tax, 15 Oct 2026): cityam.com · news.bloombergtax.com
  • Consulting: Accenture caps Claude funding at $29/employee/month (404 Media, 15 Oct 2026 (~37h old, borderline; original report).; follow-up Forbes, 16 Oct 2026): 404media.co · forbes.com

Tech

  • iPhone Duo pre-orders open Fri 16 Oct (14:00 SAST) (Apple Newsroom, updated 15 Oct 2026): apple.com
  • Meta releases Muse Spark Open, runs on M5 Ultra Mac Studios (Meta AI Research blog, 15 Oct 2026.; WSJ, 15 Oct 2026 19:00 SAST): research.meta.ai · wsj.com
  • Anthropic IPO valuation talk ~$1.5tn, down from ~$2tn; Q3 revenue +45% to $16.8bn (Reuters (via US News), 15 Oct 2026 US time / 16 Oct SAST.; Telegraph, 16 Oct 2026 03:42 SAST): money.usnews.com · telegraph.co.uk
